subject: Procurement portal: approval-ladder change + onboarding refresh for renewal and term uplift
messages:
From: Paul Hart <paul.hart@acme-health.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps Team <procureops@acme-health.com>, Karen Soto <karen.soto@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal: procurement portal changes + requested onboarding refresh

Hi Hannah —

Quick heads-up from Acme: our procurement team is rolling out new PO approval ladders and a two-tier threshold in the portal starting Nov 1. That affects the way we submit POs and how renewals are routed. We’re planning a renewal for 12/15 (annual term) and want to both increase capacity by ~25% and update the term to 12 months from the current 9-month cadence.

Can Redwood help with a short onboarding refresh (procurement portal access + new approver mapping) and confirm whether the higher capacity requires a contract amendment or if we can handle via the portal with a PO addendum?

I attached the PO thresholds doc for your ops team. Happy to jump on a short call this week.

Attachments: acme_po_thresholds_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Paul
Procurement Lead, Acme Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Paul Hart <paul.hart@acme-health.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal: procurement portal changes + requested onboarding refresh

Paul —

Thanks for the detail and the thresholds file. Quick plan:

- Ops (Alex) will validate whether the requested capacity bump (+25%) can be covered under your existing SKU/commit or needs a formal amendment.
- Finance (Ben) will confirm PO acceptance flow and whether the new approval ladder requires updated PO terms or a signed amendment.
- Legal (Laura) will review a 12-month term change and propose language for a brief SOW addendum if needed.

Next steps from our side: Alex will run a capacity check and post a recommendation by COB Tuesday. Ben — if you can confirm PO routing acceptance and whether we need a PO-to-amendment mapping that would be great. Laura — can you mark any redline priorities if we move to a 12-month term?

Paul — can you confirm the list of new approvers and whether ProcureOps will provide the portal admin change request? If you have an internal DocuSign or portal change ticket, please share the link (that’ll speed approvals).

I’ve attached the thresholds you sent for internal review.

Best,
Hannah
Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Paul Hart <paul.hart@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal: procurement portal changes + requested onboarding refresh

Hannah —

I looked through the thresholds. Short answer: we can accept the increased PO amounts via portal but three things to confirm before we sign:
1) PO must reference the Deal ID or SOW addendum (we need a clear mapping for accounting).
2) If billing frequency changes with the term change, finance needs to record start/end dates for revenue recognition.
3) For POs above $250k, our policy requires a signed amendment from Legal.

If Acme expects the capacity bump to push the annualized spend above that $250k threshold, ask them to sign a short amendment. If not, ProcureOps can submit a new PO referencing the existing contract.

I can fast-track once we have the SOW addendum (Laura) or a DocuSign link.

—Ben
Finance Director | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Paul Hart <paul.hart@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal: procurement portal changes + requested onboarding refresh

Team —

I’ve drafted a concise SOW addendum that:
- Extends term to 12 months (effective 12/15/2026)
- Documents the 25% capacity uplift (SKU and billing note)
- Adds a single-sentence billing/PO mapping clause so finance can reconcile POs to the amended term.

Redlines: replace any language that auto-renews with explicit end date and include a clause that POs over $250k require an amendment signature (per Ben). Also recommend we keep a discretionary audit window (90 days) so Acme can verify usage metrics against the SKU.

Attachment: SOW_addendum_v1.docx

If the external team agrees, we can route the addendum via DocuSign and Ben can approve for accounting once countersigned. Hannah — propose we schedule a 30-min sign-off call Thursday to confirm approvers in the portal and finalize the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Laura
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Paul Hart <paul.hart@acme-health.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps Team <procureops@acme-health.com>, Karen Soto <karen.soto@nimbushealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-23T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal: procurement portal changes + requested onboarding refresh

Hannah / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed Laura’s addendum and it looks fine from our side with two small asks: 1) keep the audit window to 60 days instead of 90, and 2) include the approver list to be added to the portal admin ticket (I pasted the approver emails below).

We’ve started the DocuSign flow — link here: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-12345

Approvers to add to portal admin ticket: karen.soto@nimbushealth.com, paul.hart@acme-health.com, finance-purchasing@acme-health.com

We’ll countersign the SOW addendum once the DocuSign is complete and then ProcureOps will submit the PO referencing Deal ACME-2026-RNW-4821. Let us know if you want the 30-min sign-off call; otherwise, we’re good to move to signatures.

Regards,
Paul
Procurement Lead, Acme Health
